title: Earthy Aerated British Narutomaki Cottage Pie
description: A unique and nutritious take on the classic cottage pie, featuring aerated vegetables and a hint of earthy flavor from the narutomaki. This keto-friendly dish is perfect for a weeknight meal or as a special treat.
instructions: In a large pan over medium heat, cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sliced mushrooms and narutomaki to the pan and cook until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate pan, sauté the aerated vegetables (such as cauliflower and broccoli) until tender.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the aerated vegetables to the baking dish with the meat mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together 1 cup of grated cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup of grated Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly over the top of the cottage pie.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
